9	 * reference only; its page-specific threshold colouring (`A5`) is

11	 * semantic tone and the interpretation: this component never infers
12	 * "good/bad" from the numeric direction.
13	 */

15	interface V2MeterBarProps {
16	  t: V2Tokens;
17	  /** Caller-owned value. No meaning is derived from it here. */
18	  score: number;
19	  /** Caller-owned range maximum — required so no default range is invented. */
20	  maxScore: number;
21	  /**
22	   * RUS-5800 rev 8 (additive): `ReactNode` labels let callers compose a
23	   * leading adornment (e.g. a country flag beside a geographic-allocation
24	   * name) without forking the meter. String labels behave exactly as before.
25	   */
26	  label?: ReactNode;
27	  showValue?: boolean;
28	  /**

30	   * omitted, the raw score is rendered as-is. Callers pass a preformatted
31	   * string (e.g. `'—'` for missing, `'72%'`, `'7.2'`) to stay truthful.

33	  valueLabel?: string;

35	  tone?: string;

41	}

43	/**

45	 * (NaN/±Infinity) and non-positive ranges clamp to 0 so garbage input can
46	 * never render a full-width fill; the CALLER decides how to flag bad data.
47	 */
48	const clampPct = (value: number, maxScore: number) => {
49	  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || !Number.isFinite(maxScore) || maxScore <= 0) return 0;
50	  return Math.min(Math.max(value / maxScore, 0), 1) * 100;
51	};
52	
53	/**
54	 * ONE validated model drives BOTH the presentation and the accessibility
55	 * attributes (PR #1129 review, revision 2): a meter only exists when the
56	 * value/range pair is a finite, sensibly-ranged measurement. For invalid
57	 * input (score or maxScore non-finite, maxScore <= 0) there is no valid

76	        // their own accessible text (e.g. CountryLabel's aria-label).
77	        'aria-label': typeof label === 'string' ? label : undefined,
78	      }
79	    : {};

81	  const track = (
82	    <Box
83	      {...meterAria}
84	      sx={{
85	        position: 'relative',
86	        flex: 1,
87	        height: '4px',
88	        borderRadius: `${t.radius.bar}px`,
89	        background: t.cardNested,
90	        overflow: marker === undefined ? 'hidden' : 'visible',
91	      }}
92	    >
93	      <Box
94	        sx={{
95	          width: `${pct}%`,
96	          height: '100%',
97	          borderRadius: `${t.radius.bar}px`,
98	          background: tone,
99	          transition: 'width 400ms ease',
100	        }}
101	      />
102	      {marker !== undefined && (
103	        <Box
104	          aria-hidden
105	          sx={{
106	            position: 'absolute',
107	            top: '-2px',
108	            left: `calc(${clampPct(marker, maxScore)}% - 1px)`,
109	            width: '2px',
110	            height: '8px',
111	            borderRadius: `${t.radius.bar}px`,
112	            background: t.textMuted,

117	  );

122	        {label && (
123	        // Rev 8: string labels keep the kit Typography treatment; ReactNode
124	        // labels (composed adornments, e.g. country flags) render inside a
125	        // Box carrying the same truncation constraints.
126	          typeof label === 'string' ? (
127	            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: 11, color: t.textSub, whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>
128	              {label}
129	            </Typography>
130	          ) : (
131	            <Box sx={{ fontSize: 11, color: t.textSub, whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', flexShrink: 0 }}>
132	              {label}
133	            </Box>
134	          )
135	        )}
136	        {track}
137	        {showValue && (
138	          <Typography
139	            sx={{
140	              fontSize: 11,
141	              fontWeight: 600,
142	              fontFeatureSettings: "'tnum' 1",
143	              color: t.textSub,
144	              minWidth: 26,
145	              textAlign: 'right',
146	            }}
147	          >
148	            {valueLabel ?? String(score)}
149	          </Typography>
150	        )}
151	      </Box>
152	    );
153	  }
154	
155	  return <Box sx={{ display: 'flex' }}>{track}</Box>;

5	export type V2BadgeVariant =
6	  | 'neutral'
7	  | 'accent'
8	  | 'success'
9	  | 'warning'
10	  | 'danger'
11	  | 'info'
12	  // RUS-5973 (PERF WS-2): the data-provenance trust palette — "this number is
13	  // modeled, not observed". Mirrors ProvenanceBadge's `simulated` state
14	  // (`ProvenanceBadge.tsx`, the identical `${t.purple}14 / t.purple /
15	  // ${t.purple}28` triple) so the two provenance badges on the Performance
16	  // page cannot diverge. Deliberately NOT the green-teal accent: on these
17	  // cards green already means a POSITIVE VERDICT, and a modelled-data label
18	  // must not read as one.
19	  | 'purple';
20	
21	interface V2BadgeProps {
22	  t: V2Tokens;
23	  label: string;
24	  variant?: V2BadgeVariant;
25	  /** B3 `chip` shape (anomaly A4 standardisation): h24 chip with an optional
26	   *  icon/dot, for icon-bearing classification chips. Colour still comes from
27	   *  `variant` — chip is anatomy, not a colour. */
28	  chip?: boolean;
29	  /** Icon rendered inside a `chip` badge (before the label). */
30	  icon?: ReactNode;
31	  /** Render a coloured status dot inside a `chip` badge (before the label). */
32	  dot?: boolean;
33	  /**
34	   * RUS-5860 (additive): SOLID triplet treatment — fills/borders/text from
35	   * the design file's chip+alert families, as drawn by the Portfolio Risk
36	   * frame badges (`5362:5954`, `5362:6246`). Default false keeps the frozen
37	   * alpha treatment for every existing consumer.
38	   */
39	  solid?: boolean;
40	  /**
41	   * RUS-5800 rev 12 (additive): chip height in px. The frozen B3 default is
42	   * 24; the recorded Figma DRAWER metadata chips are 28px tall
43	   * (`5343:3466`, node 5343:3466 block) — drawers pass 28 for that role.
44	   * Default keeps every existing consumer pixel-identical.
45	   */
46	  chipHeight?: number;
47	}
48	
49	// B3 (RUS-5795 frozen contract): non-severity status/label pill.
50	// Visual: dot-pill h20 `radius.pill` (16); `chip` h24; bg `${token}14`,
51	// border `${token}28`. Badges do NOT infer severity — the caller chooses the
52	// variant, the badge renders it.
53	export function V2Badge({ t, label, variant = 'neutral', chip = false, icon, dot, chipHeight, solid }: V2BadgeProps) {
54	  // Rev 13: an enlarged chip (recorded Figma drawer chips are 28px) scales
55	  // its label + padding with the height — the compact 24px default is
56	  // unchanged for every existing consumer.
57	  const enlarged = chip && (chipHeight ?? 24) > 24;
58	  const chipFontSize = chip ? (enlarged ? 12 : 11) : 10;
59	  const chipPx = chip ? (enlarged ? '12px' : '10px') : '8px';
60	  const colors: Record<V2BadgeVariant, { bg: string; color: string; border: string }> = {
61	    neutral: { bg: `${t.textMuted}14`, color: t.textSub, border: `${t.textMuted}28` },
62	    accent: { bg: t.accentDim, color: t.accent, border: t.accentBorder },
63	    success: { bg: `${t.positive}14`, color: t.positive, border: `${t.positive}28` },
64	    warning: { bg: `${t.warning}14`, color: t.warning, border: `${t.warning}28` },
65	    danger: { bg: `${t.negative}14`, color: t.negative, border: `${t.negative}28` },
66	    info: { bg: `${t.blue}14`, color: t.blue, border: `${t.blue}28` },
67	    purple: { bg: `${t.purple}14`, color: t.purple, border: `${t.purple}28` },
68	  };
69	  // RUS-5860: solid triplets resolve from the chip/alert token families —
70	  // built lazily so consumers with minimal token fixtures (and every
71	  // non-solid consumer) never read those groups.
72	  const c = solid
73	    ? {
74	        neutral: { bg: t.cardElevated, color: t.textSub, border: t.border },
75	        accent: { bg: t.accentDim, color: t.accent, border: t.accentBorder },
76	        success: { bg: t.chip.successBackground, color: t.chip.successText, border: t.alert.successBorder },
77	        warning: { bg: t.chip.warningBackground, color: t.chip.warningText, border: t.alert.warningBorder },
78	        danger: { bg: t.chip.errorBackground, color: t.chip.errorText, border: t.alert.errorBorder },
79	        info: { bg: t.chip.infoBackground, color: t.chip.infoText, border: t.alert.infoBorder },
80	      }[variant]
81	    : colors[variant];
82	
83	  return (
84	    <Box
85	      component="span"
86	      sx={{
87	        height: chip ? (chipHeight ?? 24) : 20,
88	        display: 'inline-flex',
89	        alignItems: 'center',
90	        gap: icon ? '4px' : chip ? '4px' : 0,
91	        px: chipPx,
92	        borderRadius: `${t.radius.pill}px`,
93	        fontSize: chipFontSize,
94	        fontWeight: 650,
95	        background: c.bg,
96	        color: c.color,
97	        border: `1px solid ${c.border}`,
98	        whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
99	      }}
100	    >
101	      {chip && dot && (
102	        <Box
103	          component="span"
104	          aria-hidden
105	          sx={{ width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: '50%', backgroundColor: c.color, flexShrink: 0 }}
106	        />
107	      )}
108	      {/* RUS-5860 R7: icons render on ANY badge shape (solid included) —
109	          the consolidation onto V2Badge relies on it; the sole pre-existing
110	          icon consumer already passed `chip`, so its rendering is
111	          unchanged. Spacing applies whenever an icon is present. */}
112	      {icon && (
113	        <Box component="span" sx={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}>
114	          {icon}
115	        </Box>
116	      )}
117	      {label}
118	    </Box>
119	  );
